## Odoo Addons (Published on Odoo Apps Store)
- [Advanced Agricultural Management](https://apps.odoo.com/apps/modules/19.0/agricultural_management): Complete farm-to-warehouse ERP for Odoo 19 — OWL Dashboard with Chart.js, 4-level farm hierarchy (Farm→Sector→Unit→House), real-time costing engine, 7-step production request workflow, harvest scheduling with Grade A/B/C sorting, full accounting & analytic integration, 12-section operations dashboard, multi-warehouse stock management, role-based security. Live demo: https://demo.xamltech.com (DB: demo, User: demo, Pass: demo)
- [POS Cutting Orders](https://apps.odoo.com/apps/modules/18.0/ma_pos_cutting): Fabric cutting management for textile POS - €149
- [POS Stock Real-Time](https://apps.odoo.com/apps/modules/18.0/ma_rs_pos_stock): Live inventory sync across POS sessions - €129
- [POS Security Framework](https://apps.odoo.com/apps/modules/18.0/ma_pos_base): Manager PIN, discount limits, session security - €99
